description: Source code for the Android AudioMixer class, handling audio track management, channel masking, downmixing, reformatting, and haptic data processing within the Android media framework.

classes.name: AudioMixer
classes.description: Main class managing audio tracks, channel configurations, and processing pipelines.

classes.name: AudioMixer::Track
classes.description: Represents individual audio tracks with methods for downmixing, reformatting, and parameter adjustments.

methods.name: isValidChannelMask
methods.description: Checks if a given audio channel mask is valid.

methods.name: setChannelMasks
methods.description: Updates channel masks for a specific track, handling downmixing and reformatting as needed.

methods.name: unprepareForDownmix
methods.description: Releases resources related to downmixing for a track.

methods.name: prepareForDownmix
methods.description: Configures downmixing buffers and formats based on track and mixer channel masks.

methods.name: unprepareForReformat
methods.description: Resets reformatting buffers for a track.

methods.name: prepareForReformat
methods.description: Sets up reformatting buffers to convert between formats.

methods.name: unprepareForAdjustChannels
methods.description: Resets channel adjustment buffers.

methods.name: prepareForAdjustChannels
methods.description: Prepares buffers for adjusting channel counts.

methods.name: unprepareForTee
methods.description: Resets tee buffer resources.

methods.name: prepareForTee
methods.description: Configures tee buffers for track output.

methods.name: clearContractedBuffer
methods.description: Clears contracted buffer data for a track.

methods.name: clearTeeFrameCopied
methods.description: Clears the frame copied status in tee buffers.

methods.name: reconfigureBufferProviders
methods.description: Reconfigures the chain of buffer providers for a track.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets various parameters for tracks, including channel masks, buffers, formats, and haptic settings.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Adjusts the playback rate and configures timestretch buffer provider.

methods.name: setBufferProvider
methods.description: Assigns a new buffer provider to a track and resets existing buffers.

methods.name: preCreateTrack
methods.description: Creates a new track instance.

methods.name: postCreateTrack
methods.description: Initializes a track after creation, setting channel masks, formats, and processing configurations.

methods.name: preProcess
methods.description: Prepares the mixer for processing, clearing contracted buffers.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Handles post-processing tasks, including haptic data scaling and buffer muting.
